title: Peace Love & Flip Flops | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home: * 6-Seater Golf Cart + 4 Bikes Included* 2 Large Porches (one screened!) for Relaxing and Dining* 2 Master Suites* Quiet Neighborhood, with biking and walking trails, and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home: * 6-Seater Golf Cart + 4 Bikes Included* 2 Large Porches (one screened!) for Relaxing and Dining* 2 Master Suites* Quiet Neighborhood, with biking and walking trails, and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest* Access to "The Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, Fire Pit, and Pickleball Courts* Walking or Biking Distance to Fabulous Shopping and Dining Options* Next to Watercolor and Seaside* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceEnjoy your next vacation at Peace Love and Flip Flops in the NatureWalk 30A Resort Community! This quiet neighborhood is surrounded by scenic bike and walking trails and offers easy access to everything 30A has to offer. You will fall in love with this beautiful home, designed for both comfort and relaxation. Peace Love and Flip Flops is a spacious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home with everything you need for a stress-free getaway. With two master en-suite bedrooms—one on each floor—a guest bedroom with a queen bed, and another guest room with twin bunk beds, this home comfortably sleeps 10 guests while providing plenty of privacy. The well-equipped kitchen is perfect for in-home dining and grilling, making mealtime a breeze.This child-friendly retreat includes a highchair, double jogging stroller, small umbrella stroller, and two Pack and Plays for added convenience. Beach days are effortless with the provided beach toys and four Tommy Bahama backpack beach chairs. Plus, the complimentary golf cart makes it easy to explore the surrounding trails, community amenities, and nearby beaches. Come make Peace Love and Flip Flops a family vacation tradition for years to come!*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Bed Set-Up:First Floor:Master Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Twin Bunk BedLoft: Sleeper SofaNatureWalk amenities include a large zero-entry pool, an additional heated lap pool, a hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded splash pool for toddlers, hammocks, outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and gas fire pit for family enjoyment. Additional amenities include 2 playgrounds, pickleball courts, and a basketball court.*Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass and $150 for a lost golf cart key. Please leave the amenity pass and the key in the home upon departure.Beach access is less than a mile from NatureWalk by bike via the "Lily Lane Beach Trail" through the beautiful Point Washington State Forest. Note: golf carts are not allowed on Lily Lane or any other state forest trails. Or drive the golf cart by road to any of the beautiful beaches along 30A.NatureWalk is ideally located on Hwy 395 off of 30A, adjacent to WaterColor and Seaside. NatureWalk is surrounded by Point Washington State Forest. Explore NatureWalk and the surrounding WaterColor and Seaside by bike or on foot. Rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore Western Lake or the gulf at Grayton Beach State Park nearby.Publix in “WaterColor Crossings” is conveniently located next to NatureWalk. There you will also find Pizza by the Sea, Boca Boutique, Marble Slab Creamery, Great American Cookie, UPS Store, Emerald Coast Wine and Spirits, Perfect Pig Restaurant, Pedego Electric Bikes, and Yellowfin Sports to meet all of your needs. The shops and restaurants of Seaside, WaterColor, and Seagrove Beach are a short bike or golf cart ride away. Don’t miss the funky shops and restaurants in Old Grayton Beach also on 30A.Area Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s finest with sugar white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses and more along the 19-mile stretch of 30A. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayaking, paddleboarding, biking, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis—you'll find it all right here. Read less
